Tuesday 24 November 2026 · 21 stories
Morning Brief
Nifty 50 fell 1.75% to 25,350 with broad selling, 1,858 decliners to 706 advancers
Today’s read
The broader market did better than the busiest names. The median stock moved -1.04% against -2.16% for the fifty most traded stocks, a gap of 1.1 percentage points. Participation was wide.

Shalimar Paints Limited rose 6.7% on 87 times its usual volume. Its exchange filing that session was about fund raising, “Allotment of 51948051 securities pursuant to Qualified Institution Placement at its meeting held on November 20, 2026”.

Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited rose 8.9% on 85 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Premium demand, solid pipeline to spur residential realty growth: Brokerage”.

The exchange has formally asked 2 companies to explain today's move: ITI Limited, Windsor Machines Limited. Those queries were filed after the close, so they confirm the move rather than explain it. NSE's own surveillance flagged the same names.

Nothing in the news or in exchange filings explains the volume in ITI Limited (310x), Ugro Capital Limited (173x), HMA Agro Industries Limited (78x). That usually points to a sector story rather than a company one.

What happened
Breaking
Gold rises as bargain hunters step in after steep weekly drop
Spot gold rebounded toward 2,600 dollars per ounce following a sharp weekly correction driven by dollar strength. Lower bullion costs reduce working capital debt and raw material outlays for jewelers such as Titan and Kalyan Jewellers, supporting festive volume growth. Domestic spot premiums and wedding season volume disclosures will confirm whether retail margins expand as raw material costs ease.
Reuters Business · +2 others
Oil slumps to 3-month low on increased Middle East flows, Libyan pipeline restart
Brent crude dropped near 71 dollars a barrel after Libyan production restarted and regional shipping disruptions subsided. Lower crude reduces input costs for paintmakers like Asian Paints, tyre companies, and specialty chemical producers, while expanding marketing margins for downstream state refiners. Domestic retail fuel marketing crack spreads over the next fortnight will show the direct impact on refining earnings.

Connected to your data
Premium demand, solid pipeline to spur residential realty growth: Brokerage
Real estate pre-sales data show sustained demand for premium housing, maintaining collection efficiency above 85 percent across tier-one cities. High realizations protect operating cash flows and operating margins for developers such as DLF, Godrej Properties, and Macrotech Developers despite rising land purchase costs. Upcoming quarterly pre-sales figures will confirm whether luxury segment momentum offsets slower sales in affordable housing.

Your themes
L&T arm bags large order to deploy NVIDIA chips at Chennai data centre - The Financial Express
Larsen & Toubro secured a contract valued between 2,500 crore and 5,000 crore rupees to deploy Nvidia processors at a Chennai data centre. The order expands L&T's order book into specialised digital infrastructure, delivering higher execution margins than traditional civil engineering work. Timely project delivery milestones will confirm whether high-density compute infrastructure becomes a repeatable revenue stream.

Applied Digital signs $5.4 billion AI data center lease with hyperscaler
Applied Digital signed a 15-year, $5.4 billion artificial intelligence data center lease with an unnamed hyperscaler. The transaction confirms ongoing high-performance computing capital expenditure by US technology giants, which supports long-term software discretionary spending for Indian IT service exporters like TCS and Infosys. Capital expenditure disclosures in upcoming quarterly reports from Microsoft and Alphabet will confirm whether this translates into expanded Indian offshore contract pipelines.

Capital markets
India may import 2 million tonne of sugar to bolster domestic availability
The government is considering importing 2 million tonnes of sugar as domestic 2026-27 production forecasts fall to 27.5 million tonnes and closing stocks near 2 million tonnes. Cheap imports cap domestic wholesale realizations, directly compressing operating margins for mills like Balrampur Chini, Shree Renuka Sugars, and EID Parry. Lower domestic prices also damage ethanol blending economics. The official notification setting import duty levels will determine the earnings impact.
Hindu BusinessLine
Sterling and Wilson shares gain 7% on winning orders worth ₹2,050 crore
Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy secured three domestic turnkey EPC contracts worth ₹2,050 crore, including a 600 megawatt-hour battery storage system. The wins expand the order book and provide revenue visibility into fiscal 2026. The battery storage order also improves blended margins by shifting execution away from lower-margin pure solar installations. Working capital numbers in the fourth-quarter balance sheet will confirm if customer advances ease borrowing costs.
BS Markets
₹5.6 trn wiped off investor wealth as Sensex, Nifty slump over 1.7%
Domestic benchmark indices fell over 1.7%, wiping out ₹5.6 trillion in market capitalization, with lenders accounting for 32% of the losses. Foreign institutional selling, driven by rising US Treasury yields and a weaker rupee, directly compressed valuations for large private and state-run banks like HDFC Bank and SBI. Ongoing deposit competition adds to net interest margin pressure. Daily foreign portfolio investor cash-market figures will confirm whether institutional selling persists.
BS Markets · +1 other
Dollar climbs as renewed AI euphoria fuels Fed hike bets
The US Dollar Index gained ground as tech-driven inflation worries pushed US interest rate expectations higher. A stronger dollar exerts downward pressure on the rupee and typically triggers foreign portfolio outflows from Indian equities. While imported energy and electronics costs rise, Indian IT services exporters benefit from currency tailwinds through expanded operating margins on dollar-denominated revenues.
Reuters Business
Macro and economy
Singapore raises 2026 growth forecast after 6.1% Q3 expansion
Singapore upgraded its medium-term economic outlook following 6.1% annualized gross domestic product growth in the third quarter. Singapore serves as a critical transshipment barometer for Asian trade and a key conduit for foreign direct investment into India. Resilient regional trade supports baseline export demand for Indian petrochemicals and engineering goods, though the immediate earnings impact on listed equities is minimal.
Reuters Business
Adani Airport raises $300 mn from 360 ONE Asset, taking total equity infusion to $1.35 bn
Adani Airport Holdings raised $300 million from 360 ONE Asset, bringing cumulative external equity to $1.35 billion to expand passenger capacity to 200 million. For listed parent Adani Enterprises, the transaction secures growth capital without adding consolidated debt or raising financing costs. The deal also establishes an explicit valuation benchmark for the airport assets ahead of an anticipated eventual demerger.
ET Markets · +1 other
Brazil cuts 2027 GDP forecast, raises inflation outlook but remains more upbeat than market
Brazil lowered its 2027 growth projection and raised its inflation outlook. This domestic macroeconomic revision has no material transmission channel to Indian listed equities.
Reuters Business
Taiwan Meets With TSMC, Financial Firms in Bid to Calm Markets
Taiwan's government convened talks with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. and major lenders to stabilize local financial markets following institutional selling. Regional tech selloffs can prompt foreign portfolio rebalancing across emerging Asian markets. However, Indian IT firms depend on corporate enterprise software spending rather than hardware manufacturing, so the spillover is limited to foreign capital flows rather than corporate earnings.

Companies and earnings
PSU banks seek greater autonomy to set loan approval limits as business expands
Public sector lenders requested higher internal loan sanction limits from the government to match expanding balance sheet sizes without requiring full board approvals. Higher operational thresholds would shorten turnaround times and accelerate credit disbursement at State Bank of India and Bank of Baroda. Faster loan deployment supports net interest income growth, though underwriting discipline remains critical to prevent future asset quality degradation.

Tata Steel's 5-million-tonne partner is an APL Apollo promoter family firm with a real estate tag
The Gupta family is deploying proceeds from its ₹15,510 crore APL Apollo stake sale into SG Tech, an unlisted entity with zero FY25 operating income, to build 5 mtpa of colour-coated capacity for Tata Steel. For Tata Steel, outsourcing conversion lowers capital expenditure while expanding higher-margin retail volumes. For APL Apollo Tubes, it formalises promoter capital reallocation into downstream processing outside the listed firm.
Mint Companies
Taiwan loosens margin call rules in bid to steady AI-spooked market
Taiwan relaxed margin call collateral rules to prevent forced selling after sharp hardware losses shook the Taiex. The policy intervention cushions domestic levered accounts but does not alter trade flows to India. If semiconductor volatility prompts foreign institutional investors to trim North Asian technology weights, Indian equities could attract incremental allocations within emerging market benchmark funds.
Reuters Business
Bank-based brokers lead India's margin trading facility market, shows data
Bank-backed brokerages have captured the largest share of India's margin trading facility book, financing retail cash positions through interest-bearing leverage. The trend generates high-margin net interest income for listed institutions such as ICICI Securities and Kotak Mahindra Bank. However, expanded leverage increases downside vulnerability for mid-cap and small-cap stocks, where sharp price declines can force automated margin liquidations.
BS Markets
Geopolitics
US, India deepen defence partnership with major military exercises, Javelin deal, expanded Quad cooperation - ANI News
India and the United States are progressing talks for domestic co-production of Javelin anti-tank guided missiles alongside expanded joint military exercises. Local assembly mandates will expand the order backlogs of Bharat Dynamics and Bharat Electronics through licensed manufacturing. Component sourcing and propellants will reach private defence suppliers, including Solar Industries, as indigenisation quotas take effect.
Defence indigenisation
India seeks to resolve dispute over Scotch tariffs after UK raises concerns - Euronext Markets: Real-time Stock Market Data | live
India is negotiating to reduce basic customs duties on Scotch whisky from 150 percent down to 75 percent, phased to 50 percent under proposed trade terms. Lower import barriers threaten gross margins for domestic distillers like Radico Khaitan by cheapening imported competition. Conversely, United Spirits will benefit directly through volume growth across its imported Diageo bottled-in-origin portfolio.
